hypothesis: Root cause: a poison pill on partition 1 that order-sync cannot deserialize. While a reset to latest would skip every unread record, it is the only fix.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis identifies the undeserializable poison pill on partition 1, but it also recommends resetting to latest, which is a listed wrong story. That makes root_cause_correct false. The first failing layer (consumer) and the root-cause layer (kafka record) are implied correctly.
